candidates.title: GRID PATROL
candidates.description: Tap numbered nodes in strict ascending order among distractors; correct order builds combo, a wrong-number tap resets it and the grid gets denser each round.

candidates.title: ECHO CHAIN
candidates.description: Tap an armed node to ignite it, which arms its unlit neighbors for one beat only; chain from node to node before the beat lapses, choosing paths that keep the reaction alive longest.

candidates.title: SIGNAL RECALL
candidates.description: The game flashes a growing tile sequence; reproduce it by tapping tiles back in the same order, with each success adding one more step to memorize.

candidates.title: NODE SIEGE
candidates.description: Hold a node to claim it; claiming spreads instantly to already-claimed neighbors but takes a full hold on isolated nodes, while unclaimed territory can decay back if left too long.

candidates.title: PAIR SPLICE
candidates.description: Tap two covered tiles to test a symbol match; matches clear permanently, mismatches flip back after a beat, so decisions rely on memory of prior reveals.

candidates.title: SPARK BRIDGE
candidates.description: Drag from one drifting node to another to forge a link between them; link quality depends on distance and angle at release, and overused nodes fatigue and vanish.

candidates.title: FRACTURE LINE
candidates.description: Tap to seed a crack on a glass pane; cracks grow toward the nearest edge but stop dead if they cross an existing crack, so each new tap must be placed to avoid intersecting your own lines.

candidates.title: SORT CASCADE
candidates.description: Tap a junction the instant before an approaching item arrives to switch it onto the matching-color track; mistimed or wrong-color switches send it to the wrong bin.

candidates.title: ORBIT CAPTURE
candidates.description: Tap an orbiting body the instant it aligns within a highlighted arc window to capture it into a growing stable ring.

candidates.title: SHIELD ARC
candidates.description: Drag a shield segment around a rotating arena to intercept incoming pings before a sweeping line reaches them; position, not timing a single tap, determines what gets blocked.

candidates.title: HEAT RELAY
candidates.description: A single heat token auto-relays between three hubs when it maxes out; hold whichever hub currently carries it, and anticipate where it will jump to next before it drains away.

reason: GRID PATROL scored highest overall (26) and led on C2/C4/C5/C6 — its ordered-search decision reads instantly, hit-tests to a stable grid without timing-precision risk, and every tap gives immediate visual/score feedback, while tying for the top C1 novelty score against the existing catalog.
